items.excerpt: # Queue and resource models **Question.** How should capacity, occupancy and waiting time be related in a queue model, and when does a finite-window measurement mislead? **Short answer.** Arrival rate, service capacity, utilization and occupancy are related but not interchangeable. Little's law connects average occupancy, arrival rate and average time in system under stated conditions. A finite simulation window is not the long-run average, so the model must report the window, the warmup and the uncertainty.
items.question: Which quantities govern growth and drainage of the modeled modernization dual-write backlog?
items.title: Queue and resource models

It also stores a result hash over the record's substantive fields.
